name: Blue Zone Hike
description: Discover Nicoya’s Blue Zone on a mountain hike with ocean views, hidden waterfalls, and an optional traditional Blue Zone lunch.
longDescription: Discover the natural beauty of Nicoya’s Blue Zone on an adventurous mountain hike through tropical landscapes, scenic ocean views, and hidden waterfalls. This 3 mile (4 km) round-trip trail combines uphill and downhill hiking, natural rock climbing, and refreshing waterfall exploration. Experience the active lifestyle that helps define this famous region of longevity, and finish your adventure with a delicious traditional lunch inspired by the local Blue Zone diet. A perfect combination of nature, cardio, adventure, and local culture — all at your own pace.
whatToBring: Water bottle (can be refilled on site)

packageOptions.description: Guided hike with fruits, water refill, and walking stick — no lunch or transportation
Everything in Hike only, plus a traditional Blue Zone lunch — no transportation
Full experience: guided hike, Blue Zone lunch, and round-trip transportation

name: Crystal Beach Snorkeling Experience
tagline: A Hidden Coastal Adventure in Nosara, Costa Rica
description: A local boat adventure with Pacific snorkeling and a visit to a hidden beach known for natural quartz crystals.
longDescription: Discover a different side of Nosara’s Pacific coast through an authentic local boat adventure combining snorkeling, coastal exploration, and natural treasures. Travel aboard a traditional local boat — the perfect way to explore the coastline and reach some of its more secluded natural spots. Enjoy snorkeling in the Pacific waters and discover a unique hidden beach known for its natural quartz crystals. Take in the beauty of the coastline and enjoy fresh seasonal fruit during the trip. Explore the Pacific. Discover hidden treasures. Experience the local way.
bookingNote: Departure times are adjusted according to the daily low tide and ocean conditions. Our team will confirm the best departure time for your experience.

packageOptions.description: Local boat adventure, snorkeling gear, crystal beach visit, and fresh fruit — meet at the departure point
Everything included, plus round-trip transportation from Nosara

name: Mangrove Tour
description: Explore Nosara's mysterious mangroves by kayak or paddleboard — calm waters, local wildlife, and fun for all ages.
longDescription: Glide through Nosara's pristine mangrove waterways on a kayak or paddleboard with an experienced local guide. Spot birds, monkeys, and other wildlife while learning about this unique coastal ecosystem. Life jackets and fresh fruit are included. Suitable for all ages and skill levels. Transportation may be arranged for an additional cost — please inquire when booking.

name: Waterfall Tour
description: Discover Nosara's hidden waterfalls — Mala Noche, Pilas Blancas, Angeles, and Belen.
longDescription: Explore some of Nosara's most beautiful waterfalls on a guided tour through lush jungle trails. Depending on conditions and season, visits may include Mala Noche, Pilas Blancas, Angeles, and Belen waterfalls — each with its own unique charm. Transportation may be arranged for an additional cost — please inquire when booking.

name: Snorkeling Tour
description: Guided snorkeling from the shore with equipment included — boat tour available for an additional cost.
longDescription: Discover colorful marine life in the clear waters around Nosara. We start from the shore with all snorkeling equipment included and fresh fruit provided. A boat tour can also be arranged for an additional cost depending on conditions and your preferences. Transportation may be arranged for an additional cost — please inquire when booking.

name: Organic Coffee Tour
description: Visit an organic coffee farm and learn the full bean-to-cup process, with lunch included.
longDescription: Join us for an educational journey through Costa Rica's renowned coffee culture. Visit a local organic coffee farm where you'll learn about planting, harvesting, processing, and sustainable practices. Along the way, discover medicinal plants and their traditional uses. Lunch is included, and the tour concludes with a delicious coffee tasting. Transportation may be arranged for an additional cost (ATV or car) — please inquire when booking.

transportationOptions.description: Drive yourself to the coffee farm (directions provided)
ATV transportation may be arranged for an additional cost — inquire when booking
Private car service may be arranged for an additional cost — inquire when booking

name: Nature Hike
description: Trek through lush forest trails with a local guide who shares knowledge of Nosara's rich ecosystem and wildlife.
longDescription: Immerse yourself in the biodiversity of Costa Rica's tropical forests on this guided nature hike. Our expert guides lead you through scenic trails, pointing out flora and fauna while sharing deep knowledge of the local ecosystem. Transportation may be arranged for an additional cost — please inquire when booking.

name: Birdwatching
description: Early-morning birdwatching in Nosara's diverse habitats — motmots, trogons, hummingbirds, and more.
longDescription: With dozens of vibrant bird species in its diverse habitats, Nosara is a birdwatcher's paradise. Our guides know exactly where to find the region's most spectacular birds across mangroves, dry forests, and coastal ecosystems. Tour availability depends on the season. Transportation may be arranged for an additional cost — please inquire when booking.

name: ATV Tours
description: Guided ATV adventures — river, coffee farm, waterfall, and coast routes available. Contact us for pricing.
longDescription: Experience Nosara from a different perspective on a guided ATV tour. Choose from river tours, coffee farm routes, waterfall adventures, or coast tours — each tailored to your group's experience and comfort level. Helmets and safety briefing included, with optional lunch and fresh fruit available. For pricing and availability, please contact us directly.
